Name: Agricultural Company
Author: Saebyeol
Description: Production UI icon-asset stability release: replaces the broken embedded Base64 icon atlas with a real PNG asset loaded through SMAPI, with a generated fallback atlas so icon failures can no longer force the production menu to close. Keeps the reference-style Production 2.0 UI, product/process icons, production lines, process flow, plans, intermediate inventory, finished-goods grades, vanilla-crop production, optional Crop Genetics integration, contracts, brand progression, and equal-partner multiplayer.
